jobs.program: Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program 2027 (clerkships over summer 2027/28)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide window binding on all participating NSW employers; applications open 9 June 2027 at 9:00am AEST, but the Law Society sets two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) depending on the employer, so a single confirmed close date cannot be given; eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.

jobs.notes: Open-market graduate applications open 22 February 2027 at 9:00am AEST and close 4 April 2027 at 11:59pm AEST, with interviews from 27 April 2027 and offers from 2 June 2027; aimed at final-year law students.

Allens' own graduate site confirms the 2026 round has closed and that applications for the May 2027 program will open in March 2027, but gives only the month and no exact open or close dates; open to pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd-year undergraduate law or 1st-year JD).
